records.Name: Loot Hunter · Spiko Hotel
records.Des: Welcome to the wildest show Nova City has ever seen—Loot Hunter! This season, we’ve brought in famous Nova City musician Lemon Sour to take on the role of Ashlee, the boss of the Four Seas Gang. She’ll be leading our cast on a heart-pounding mission of vengeance against her arch-nemesis Balvi—played by none other than Nova’s blockbuster action star Hendrick!#rNo studio—every bit of pulse-pounding action happens in real locations! No rehearsals—every decision could make the difference between victory or defeat. Every ounce of effort on this show means cold hard cash in your bank account! Loot Hunter’s sign-ups are open to everyone, regardless of stage experience! Craving fortune and fame? Then come test your mettle and write your own story! Sign up now for the wildest adventure of your life!

records.Name: Plan: Assault
records.Des: How does the old saying go? When in doubt, use brute force. Your crew will assault Balvi’s heavily-guarded underground vault head-on. Per Ashlee’s intel, you’ll need the keycard to Balvi’s armory, high-explosive charges to blow the vault door, and a prototype sports car parked in the hotel lobby as a getaway.

records.Name: Plan: Stealth Run
records.Des: In and out without a trace. That’s how the professionals do it, so that’s the plan. Your crew will secretly infiltrate Balvi’s underground vault. To pull it off, you’ll need night vision goggles, EMP bombs, and an acid gun to melt through the vault door. As for where to find them, Ashlee has some intel.

records.Name: Plan: Disguise
records.Des: Pose as a celebrity and slip into the vault on the day of the party. You’ll need an invitation to attend the party, a portable drill to crack the vault door, and information on the vault’s flood security system to escape by submarine. It may sound insane, but according to Ashlee’s intel, it’s by no means mission impossible.
